get.description: Page through assets with their creation time, size, last read, last write and retention state, computed as of one instant. Unknown values are null and never read as stale or fresh. Filters: provider, kind, status, last-read window, retention status, legal hold and read coverage. Paging is by page and size, or by keyset: send after=<nextAfter of the previous page> and size=N to walk the assets in assetUri order without a page shifting when assets are written; the walk ends when nextAfter is null.

parameters.description: Keyset cursor: the assetUri of the last row already seen (the previous page's nextAfter). Needs page 0 and the default assetUri ascending sort. Absent or blank: ordinary page and size paging.
